Muni-only Day Passes, cable car tickets, and Visitor Passports remain available in the app during 2026; single-ride retirement does not mean the whole app has closed.

青年、长者、Clipper Access 或 START 乘客：要用对应优惠 C: Youth, Senior, Clipper Access, and START riders need the applicable discount Clipper card for those program fares. A direct bank-card tap charges adult fare.
多人同行：每位乘客分别准备自己的付款卡或设备。一次行程的进出站使用同一张卡或同一: Each rider needs their own payment card or device. Use the same card or device when tapping in and out; do not switch between plastic, phone, and watch.

This is not a fixed $2.85 rebate or an all-day free pass. Complete required exit taps; discount cards follow their own fare rules.

先给每位同行者选定付款媒介；再把去程与返程分别查好，不为追换乘优惠赶车；最后核对: Choose a payment method for each rider, plan outward and return trips separately without rushing for a discount, and check pass coverage: Muni-only Day Pass excludes cable cars while Visitor Passport differs.
